text:
diego: Planning a coordinated change tonight 22:00 UTC. Services: api v3.5.1 (header gate), runtime v10.2.0 (kernel selector + quant), router v1.8.0 (routing-table split + header preservation), console v2.3.0 (client header compatibility). Need order, pin plan, quick smoke and rollback hooks.

meera: Proposal: small smoke of runtime behind API-gate before router flip. Order suggestion: API -> runtime-smoke -> router -> runtime-full -> console. Rollback reverse.

deploy-bot: Waves created by @diego:
- wave-1 API v3.5.1 2024-09-01 22:00 UTC — canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% (10m holds)
- wave-2 Runtime v10.2.0 smoke 22:15 UTC — gated by header `x-canary-runtime:v10` (1% 10m)
- wave-3 Router v1.8.0 22:30 UTC — `preserve-legacy-headers=true` for 20m, gradual split
- wave-4 Runtime v10.2.0 full 22:50 UTC — expand to 5% -> 25%
- wave-5 Console v2.3.0 23:10 UTC — FF off, enable after checks

deploy-bot: Rollback commands registered: `deployctl rollback <service> --to-last-stable`

runbook-bot: Auto-pause triggers:
```
api_p95 > 900ms for 5m
api_5xx > 0.7% for 3m
router_header_drop > 6/min
runtime_kernel_oom >=1 node in 5m
console_js_errors > 4% in 10m
```
On trigger: pause current wave, notify #incidents and @oncall. If severe, rollback last service changed.

meera: I'll run the smoke: `infra/smoke/kv-parity.sh --header x-canary-runtime:v10` and watch kernel selector logs. Also add sidecar exemption so header not normalized.

diego: I'll handle pinning: keep API pinned to old router routes until router hits 25% and header-preserve validated for two intervals. Release notes embargo until +30m after final wave. Everyone ack.

meera: ack

diego: ack

deploy-bot: wave-1 started 22:00 UTC — api 2%

(see runbook for live updates)
